summary: Defines how an application client can use credentials obtained through OAuth together with the Simple Authentication and Security Layer (SASL). This lets protocols that use SASL, such as email protocols, access a protected resource using OAuth tokens instead of passwords.

eli5.summary: Instead of handing over your password, you show a special ticket that someone you trust gave you. This lets email programs use such tickets.

questions: how to use oauth with sasl
what is the sasl oauthbearer mechanism
